title: HeiQ and Archroma win ITMF International Collaboration Award 2026
content:
HeiQ and Archroma received the ITMF International Collaboration Award 2026 for advancing sustainable textile innovation through their strategic partnership.
Combining HeiQ’s material technologies with Archroma’s global reach, the collaboration expands access to antimicrobial and odour-control solutions, including bio-based HeiQ Mint, while supporting efficient implementation by mills and brands.

title: Asia PFY prices rise 4.91%: How long can the crude-driven rise last?
content:
PFY markets across India, China and Pakistan firmed during September 14–18, 2026, with TexPro benchmarks rising 1.4 per cent to 4.9 per cent week on week.
A Middle East-driven crude oil spike moved through the polyester feedstock chain, prompting higher DTY, POY and FDY offers.
Pakistan POY led gains at 4.91 per cent, while Chinese producers kept firmer offers despite subdued downstream buying.

title: Asia cotton markets diverge: China drops 2.56%, India holds firm
content:
TexPro data show Asia’s sustainable and mainstream cotton markets diverged, with China’s BCI 3128B spot price down 2.56 per cent from Monday to Friday.
Pakistan’s KCA BCI fell 1.01 per cent, while Organic KCA rose 1.16 per cent and held steady after Tuesday.
India’s organic Shankar-6, BCI and recycled cotton benchmarks stayed unchanged ahead of October procurement.

title: Vietnam’s $48 bn textile goal faces a 64% domestic fabric gap
content:
Vietnam's textile and apparel exports reached nearly $31.7 billion in January-August 2026, up 2.9 per cent, against a full-year target of about $48 billion.
Fabric imports hit $8.936 billion in January-July; domestic fabric output meets only around 36 per cent of demand.
The US absorbed 38.9 per cent of HS 61-62 exports in H1, as tariffs and EU traceability rules make value capture decisive.

title: North Indian cotton yarn weakens as buyers limit fresh purchases
content:
Cotton yarn prices fell by ₹2 per kg in Ludhiana and Delhi amid payment constraints, weak downstream demand and cautious buying before new-crop arrivals.
Panipat’s recycled yarn market saw limited buying as manufacturers held sufficient festival stocks and home-textile export uncertainty persisted.
North Indian cotton recovered by ₹50 per maund with ICE futures before easing after higher levels.

title: Vietnam proposes easing foreign investment rules, widening green lanes
content:
Vietnam’s Ministry of Finance has proposed changes to investment rules to ease selected market access conditions for foreign investors.
The draft would extend green-lane procedures beyond functional zones, potentially shortening project timelines.
Manufacturers, exporters and sourcing teams tracking Vietnam expansion plans may see clearer approval routes if reforms pass.

title: Benninger showcases advanced dyeing systems at Dhaka seminar
content:
Benninger showcased its FabricMaster and SynthMaster dyeing systems to more than 100 textile entrepreneurs and executives at a Dhaka seminar.
The technologies are designed to improve dyeing efficiency and fabric quality while reducing water, energy and chemical consumption.
The company also expressed confidence in Bangladesh’s textile sector despite power-supply challenges.

title: India-New Zealand FTA ratified, wool to get tariff-free access
content:
New Zealand and India have ratified their free trade agreement, with the pact set to enter into force on October 20, 2026. 
Wool is among New Zealand exports to India that will be tariff-free from day one. 
Exporters will also benefit from a second tariff-cut round on January 1, 2027, alongside preferential quota access for several products.

title: Nike reunites with University of Miami in multi-year partnership
content:
Nike and the University of Miami will begin a new multi-year partnership in July 2027, reuniting the brands 40 years after Miami became Nike’s first all-sport university partner. 
Miami will enter Nike’s Blue Ribbon Elite program, while Nike will supply team uniforms and gear, fan retail offerings, premium heritage collections and Nike Sport Research Lab resources.

title: Bangladesh’s $38.7 bn apparel engine has an 88% gas risk
content:
Bangladesh’s RMG exports reached $38.70 billion in FY2025-26, and July-August 2026 shipments rose 5.12 per cent.
Mapped in Bangladesh lists 2,933 of 3,320 export-oriented factories in Titas-served districts, including Dhaka, Gazipur and Narayanganj.
TexPro shows five product groups make up 79.69 per cent of apparel export value, while Europe and North America account for 86.37 per cent.

title: US' Nike unveils custom speed suit for Keely Hodgkinson
content:
Nike has unveiled a one-of-one speed suit for 800-meter runner Keely Hodgkinson, designed through athlete-led research to reduce drag, aid thermoregulation and support mobility.
The handcrafted hooded suit features 3D-printed vortex generators, while the new Nike Victory Elite spikes add a tuned Air Zoom unit, carbon plate and titanium pins for racing.
